codeReview.summary: The fix adds visible worker-row toggles, arrow buttons, and a `Mark All Present` button near the top of `mark-attendance-tab.tsx`, but the redesign is still not wired into the existing attendance data flow. Existing records are still loaded into the old single-worker `cellData` grid, the new row controls read/write a separate `workerAttendance` map that is never hydrated or saved, the old From/To range UI still remains underneath, and the new CTA is inline rather than sticky. The prior attendance blockers therefore remain unresolved.

issues.description: The redesigned worker rows read status from `workerAttendance.get(worker.id)`, but `loadAttendance()` still fetches attendance only for `selectedWorker` into `cellData` (lines 250-301). Because `workerAttendance` is never hydrated from fetched records, the new Full/Half/Absent pills do not reflect existing attendance data for the worker list.

The new row toggles and `handleMarkAllPresent()` only mutate the separate `workerAttendance` map, while unsaved-change detection and persistence still run solely through `cellData`/`handleSave()` (lines 474-541 and 1567-1678). As implemented, interacting with the redesigned worker list cannot create/update attendance records, so the fix regresses the tab's save flow instead of adapting the existing state management.

The new arrow navigator only updates `selectedDate` for display, but that date is never used by loading or saving logic; actual data flow still uses `rangeStart`/`dateRange`, and the old From/To date-range picker UI remains rendered below (lines 1046-1115). This leaves the required arrow-based date navigator as a cosmetic add-on rather than the real attendance date control.

The new `Mark All Present` button is rendered inline inside the `ScrollView`, so it scrolls away with content instead of staying always visible. The only bottom-anchored control is still the conditional save bar at lines 1567-1678, so the prior blocker requiring an always-visible sticky `Mark All Present` CTA is still not satisfied.

summary: Fail: although commit `531159c` adds the requested attendance UI chrome, the new worker list, date navigator, and `Mark All Present` button are disconnected from the existing load/save pipeline and do not replace the old date-range flow. The attendance fix therefore does not actually clear the prior scrutiny blockers.
